orientation.description: Twenty-two selected upright spatial rows around right/bottom and twenty-one opposite-orientation rows, clockwise180. Their relation/order and joins unresolved. Dark vertical/horizontal ruling crosses some bodies, especially final runs; masks have unknown physical length. Ordinary date-like writing excluded; terminal question/numeral-like roles unassigned.
orientation.coordinate_convention: xyxy continuous image-edge coordinates. Native→CW90: (x,y)→(1175-y,x); native→CW270: (x,y)→(y,1785-x); native→CW180: (x,y)→(1785-x,1175-y). Bounds are broad whole-block context, not exact rows or physical bodies.

interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [To my one and only sweetheart?; ? requires q → K.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Do Prahy dorazil jsem dobře?; ? requires g → Z; place and journey remain an interpretation.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [I arrived safely in Prague?; ? requires g → Z; place/journey not historically authenticated.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Který trval až do půl osmé?; q/g choices required; grammatical antecedent remains in preceding fragment.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Which lasted until half past seven?; q/g choices required; antecedent belongs to a separate fragment.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Nekonečně více rád, než jsem…?; conditional q/g choices.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Infinitely more fond … than I have…?; conditional q/g choices; incomplete clause.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: VASNIVEJI, NE? JSEM PRI SCHU?CE UCINIL.
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Vášnivěji, než jsem při schůzce učinil?; both ? require g → Z, CH provisional.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [More passionately than I did at our meeting?; both ? require g → Z and provisional CH.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Dostala jsi se domů?; tázací výklad je redakční: závěrečné ? je nevyřešený znak/role, nikoli ověřená interpunkce; předchozí neznámá skupina je vynechána.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Did you get home?; question reading is editorial: terminal ? is an unresolved glyph/role, not established punctuation; preceding unknown group excluded.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [HYCH, vášnivých…; HYCH is an unresolved cross-row ending; CH provisional.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [HYCH, passionate…; HYCH is a detached cross-row ending; provisional CH.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [A jedině tvůj Pepouš; nickname not an identity.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [And only your Pepouš; nickname not an identification.]
